title: Expert Network Market Valued at $4.19B in 2025, Growing at 16% CAGR Through 2034
summary: Business Research Insights estimates the global expert network market at $4.19 billion in 2025, projected to reach $18.03 billion by 2034 at a 16% CAGR. Note: BRI's broader methodology yields higher figures than Inex One's ~$3B estimate for 2025, which counts only direct expert-network revenue. BRI reports Asia Pacific leads with 47% market share and PE applications represent 52% of overall usage.
